properties.description:

morning, with isolated thunderstorms possible for areas south of
Solana Beach. Any thunderstorm can produce lightning and gusty,
erratic winds to 35 knots.

Mariners should move to safe harbor immediately until the storms
pass. Improved conditions are expected by 10 AM.

properties.areaDesc: Marshall; Roberts; Codington; Grant; Hamlin; Deuel
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 17 at 9:28AM CDT by NWS Aberdeen SD
properties.description:
Strong southwest winds continue over and especially along the
eastern slopes of the Sisseton Hills as gusts have ranged from 40
to 50 mph. Wind gusts to 50 mph are possible through the late
morning with winds diminishing a bit midday. However, gusts could
still peak to around 40 mph along the eastern slopes of the
Sisseton Hills through the afternoon and evening before
diminishing overnight. These gusty winds will blow around
unsecured objects and could make traveling difficult for high
profile vehicles at times.
